pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sharply defined polygonal dark regions on the neck transition to smaller, more irregular and angular patches on the mid-flank. Edges show high-contrast pixel gradients with distinct vertices and minimal blurring at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned grid with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the lateral surface. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-shaped), forming a consistent topological web that separates the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense mane is visible along the dorsal neck, creating a fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail is partially visible on the right margin, appearing as a narrow, dark-bordered structure resting against the posterior flank and bisecting the light-colored corridor network.
